review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped the MorphismProperty directory and Mathlib for other uses of `Quotient.functor` and `HasQuotient`, and found no competing definition. The only candidate was `MorphismProperty.quotient`, which is an exact (not up to isomorphism) image of `W` under `Quotient.functor`. I did not open the definition of the generic `MorphismProperty.map`. From memory it is an up-to-isomorphism image, so it would be a different representation. Even if the two agreed here, the rubric says a named specialisation implemented via a generic map is not a defect. `HasQuotient` is a new class expressing compatibility with `homRel`. It is not a duplicate of Mathlib's `HasQuotient` for algebraic quotients, which is only a name clash. `iff_of_eqvGen` is a lemma, so it is excluded from this rubric. I found no justified consolidation.
